sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Two more ⚠️ WARNING checks on a release tracklist, from the track's own data and with no requests: a title that names a remixer ("Everlasting (Psyche remix)") while the track credits no remixer, and a medley title ("A / B") whose recording links works for fewer of its parts. Anonymous mixes ("(Extended Mix)", "(mono mix)", "(5.1 mix)") and non-musical parts in square brackets ("[band intro]") are not counted; the cell's tooltip names the remixer or the counts. The remix rules come from majkinetor's Credit Hoarder. Each tint has its own switch in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ Findings.
